messages:
maria: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands customer wins/losses section. Wanted to capture a few clarifying Qs and proposed next steps so we don't lose momentum. TL;DR: we win on predictable migrations + clear cost visibility; we lose on security integrations, unclear latency SLAs, and some failure modes in long-context generation.

sam: Thanks for pulling this together. From revenue ops: we should rank fixes by deal impact (signed ARR risk). Private/KMS asks have the highest near-term dollar impact.

alex: Engineering note: the long-context failures are mostly around KV eviction and model variance on safety prompts. Short-term mitigations: (1) hardened retry logic at the router, (2) a fallback model family tuned for stability. Both feasible in ~3-5 wks with a small squad.

leila: Product perspective: customers repeatedly ask for a "migration checklist" and a one-pager that outlines expected cost delta and perf SLOs. Can we standardize a template? Cass, can CS/AE help sample a few closed-lost deals so we can be concrete?

cass: I can grab 4 recent lost deals and redact notes. Also will draft the migration checklist template with sections: prerequisites (KMS/SOC), testing plan (traffic shapes), rollback plan, and go-live validation.

maria: Cool. Leadership Q: who will own (1) customer-facing one-pager, (2) SLA packaging for p99 latency tiers, (3) ownership of the fallback-model rollout plan? Please @mention owners so we can track.

sam: I'll take (2) SLA packaging and sync with legal/security. @alex take (3) or nominate eng lead?

alex: I'll own (3) and propose a small canary plan. @leila can you own (1) with Cass/AE input?

leila: Happy to own (1). Can the comms team help with the outward language? We should avoid promising hard p99 numbers until SLA is formalized.

cass: Draft checklist + two example sales bullets per lost deal by EOW. Will post in the doc and ping here.

maria: Tech ask for Eng/Product: please drop a minimal eval prompt set for the long-context safety cases by Thursday so Alex can validate the fallback variant. Link to shared folder: https://redwood.internal/evals (placeholder).

ops-bot: Created ticket RW-555 in infra/serving: "Fallback model canary + KV eviction monitoring" assigned to alex, linked to all-hands thread 2281123581.

maria: Great. Action summary: sam (SLA packaging + legal), alex (fallback + canary), leila/cass (one-pager + checklist), maria (collect evals + coordinate comms). Proposed 20m sync Friday 9:30am. React with :thumbsup: to confirm or suggest a different time.
